title: p2 - 3 things never paste into AI

beats.say: Stop. Do not paste that into the chatbot!
Why? It's just my work stuff.
That is exactly the problem. Some chats you share can end up public.
In twenty twenty five, shared ChatGPT links were showing up in search results. The feature was removed after people noticed.
Okay. So what should I never paste?
One, passwords and API keys. Two, private client data. Three, anything you would not put on a billboard.
Honestly I did the first one last week.
Then rotate that key today. And if you build apps, use code A T 100 on Base forty four. Link in bio.
Be honest. Which one have you done?

caption:
3 things you should NEVER paste into an AI chat. Number 1 is the one everybody does.

Building your own app? Use code AT100 on Base44 (link in bio).

Which one have you done? Comment 1, 2 or 3.
